minimal_fixes: none: vwap.py imports everything it uses

eligibility.reason: guide 2.1: legacy_reproduction is diagnostic / in-sample reference only

attribution.detail: the legacy reproduction and canonical_v1 enter on exactly the same bars; the repairs on this fixture change timing and accounting, not the signal

SD-VWAP-01.before_semantics: helpers index past the end of short inputs
SD-VWAP-01.after_semantics: explicit warmup readiness: too-short input yields a valid no-signal state, never a crash and never a silent zero

SD-VWAP-02.before_semantics: entry at the signal close with levels from that price
SD-VWAP-02.after_semantics: close decision, next-open fill, levels from the actual fill

SD-VWAP-03.before_semantics: the time stop is tested before the price stop and the take profit
SD-VWAP-03.after_semantics: a frozen priority: stop, then take profit, then the time stop as a close decision
SD-VWAP-03.expected_effect: changes which exit wins on a bar where both trigger; applied identically to every arm

SD-VWAP-04.before_semantics: the dynamic VWAP exit uses the current bar's completed VWAP as an intrabar level
SD-VWAP-04.after_semantics: exit_at_vwap is OFF in the canonical pilot; when enabled it is the resting previous-observed-VWAP variant, registered before any result is seen
SD-VWAP-04.expected_effect: removes a look-ahead exit; registered ahead of performance, not switched off because a backtest looked bad

SD-VWAP-05.before_semantics: the HTF EMA is joined on the resample label with a trailing ffill
SD-VWAP-05.after_semantics: the join is on available_at from a closed HTF bucket, with warmup convergence from the EMA span rather than a hardcoded 200 bars
SD-VWAP-05.expected_effect: removes any dependence on the resample label convention

attribution_rule: every difference must map to a semantic delta. A legacy entry that falls inside the canonical warmup window is attributed to the readiness repairs; an unattributed difference is a defect in the adapter, not a result.
claim_boundary: the legacy tier is diagnostic and in-sample only. Neither side is a performance claim, and a canonical result is never compared against a legacy number as if they were arms.
